ARDX.title: New Cross-Study Analysis from Spherix Global Insights Combines Physician, Dietitian and Patient Chart Data to Show Access Barriers Still Curbing Xphozah Uptake Ahead of the TDAPA Cliff
ARDX.summary: A new analysis by Spherix Global Insights reveals that access barriers, not efficacy issues, are limiting Xphozah (tenapanor) uptake in the dialysis hyperphosphatemia market. Nephrologists report they would nearly triple Xphozah use without reimbursement and coverage obstacles. However, the drug faces persistence challenges with gastrointestinal tolerability causing discontinuation rates to double to 8%. The findings also show physicians significantly overestimate phosphorus control and combination therapy use among patients. As the TDAPA reimbursement program expires at the end of 2026, phosphate-lowering therapies will face a flattened competitive landscape.

PRCT.summary: PROCEPT BioRobotics faces a securities class action lawsuit for failing to disclose material inventory issues. The company revealed on February 25, 2026 that handpiece sales had materially exceeded procedures since Q1 2023, resulting in over 10,000 units of excess field inventory. Investors who purchased shares between February 28, 2024 and February 25, 2026 can file lead plaintiff applications by September 22, 2026.

PRCT.title: Erasca, Inc. Notice of August 10, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline

PRCT.title: ROSEN, A GLOBALLY RECOGNIZED FIRM, Encourages PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – PRCT
